rust_summary: a right-click on an entity with the point clicked (`native_entity_interact_specific`).
doc_summary: a right-click on an entity with the point clicked: `native_entity_interact_specific` hears the entity, its type, the held stack and the point clicked, measured from the entity's position, before `native_interact_entity`, as NeoForge's `PlayerInteractEvent.EntityInteractSpecific`; a claim swings the hand and ends the click. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:entity_interact_specific@.
